name: N-t-butyltryptamine
summary: N-tert-Butyltryptamine (NtBT) is a psychoactive drug of the tryptamine family related to psychedelics like dimethyltryptamine (DMT).

uses.text: NtBT was briefly described by Alexander Shulgin in his book TiHKAL (Tryptamines I Have Known and Loved).

summaryZh: N-叔丁基色胺是一種色胺衍生物，化學式為C14H20N2，最早由亞歷山大·舒爾金合成。

fact.en: It was briefly mentioned by the chemist Alexander Shulgin in TiHKAL, his 1997 book on tryptamines written with Ann Shulgin.
fact.zh: 化學家亞歷山大．舒爾金曾在他與安．舒爾金合著、1997 年出版的色胺專書《TiHKAL》中簡短提及它。
fact.zhHans: 化学家亚历山大．舒尔金曾在他与安．舒尔金合著、1997 年出版的色胺专书《TiHKAL》中简短提及它。
